name: std/runtime
description: The closed kernel: what the compiler emits calls into without the programmer naming it, and what must exist before any module can load. Allocation and the collector, module loading and type descriptors, activities and AWAIT, the platform binding, the clock.

recovered_from_misc.note: BIT (empty leaf), Locks (runtime-only), Debugging (pulls only Locks) were mis-filed in the misc pile but are import-closed shared primitives with high fan-in. Verified sealed; sunk to tier 0.

platform.note: Glue, Machine, Unix, UnixFiles are the Unix64/Linux64 platform layer. On a future multi-platform SDK these resolve to the target's variant ([Platform.]Module.Mod).

residual: The boundary is the Go and Zig one: a module belongs here iff generated code references it, or iff the loader cannot run without it. It is CLOSED -- nothing here imports anything from a package above, and docker/gen-headless-core.sh would not notice if it did, so the property is worth re-checking by hand when a module is added.

The trap handler, the dynamic loader and the file system used to be here and are not: Traps needs Streams, Loader needs Files, and a runtime that imports the library is not a runtime. They are in std/system, which sits above std/base.
